message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the appropriate charge(s) for the given facts.

Facts: Defendant Zhen applied for a credit card at ICBC Zhangye branch. Since April 2015, he repeatedly made large malicious overdrafts (i.e., credit card fraud). Bank repeatedly demanded repayment, but he didn't pay. By May 2, 2017, he owed principal 99,996.53 yuan. After the case, he and relatives repaid all principal, interest, penalty. No dispute. Evidence includes testimonies, application materials, transaction details, repayment vouchers, identity info.

Thus the crime is credit card fraud (信用卡诈骗). In the list, there is "信用卡诈骗". Also possibly "诈骗" but the specific label is "信用卡诈骗". So answer: [罪名]信用卡诈骗<eoa>

Check if any other charges: maybe "金融凭证诈骗"? But credit card fraud is a type of financial fraud. The examples show similar case: earlier example about credit card fraud gave answer "信用卡诈骗". So we use that.

Thus final answer: [罪名]信用卡诈骗<eoa>
